generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as reserved Catogery-IIA as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
GST will be paid as per the present rates at 18%, if GST revises (Increases or Decreases) same shall be paid accordingly as per the Govt Circular No: FD 417 EXP-12/2024 Date: 09/08/2024.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of KPPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder
To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should give all details and documents as per Technical and Financial bid attached to this tender.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.

All necessary arrangements shall be made and precaution taken to prevent completely or partially, damage to the structure or labours / employees during construction period. (As per recent Labour Act) Contractor shall be fully responsible for any damage to the structure during the construction and maintainance period. Any damage caused due to any reasons shall be rectified / replaced at his own cost as per the direction of Engineer in charge. Nothing shall be payable by the Department on account of inclusive of all such arrangements/ precautions work needed.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards labour welfare fund.
The employer reserves the rights to Reject one or all Tenders without assigning any reasons.

The Item Rates quoted shall include cost of Royalty charges on constructive materials & other taxes as per the rates prevailing Government Orders at the time of execution and including cost and conveyance of all materials, curing, loading and unloading with all leads and lifts, labour, hire charges of machinery & equipment etc., complete and all incidental charges. All the items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of work.
The awarded Contractor has to Submit his bills through e-MB for payment.( Billing is through e-Mb ie: Contractor has to produce Soft copy and hard Copy of RA or Final bill for payments)
Department will not supply any materials.

The construction materials (minerals metal ,sand and Murom) shall be bought from the authorized quarries along with the mineral dispatch permit or else 5 times the royalty will be deducted as penalty as per the Directions on the Director, Mines and Geology Department Bangalore proceedings dated 25.03.2013.
The amount put to tender and tendered amount are exclusive of GST.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/95/LET/2013 Bangalore dated 01.04.2013 the Contractor shall be registered under section 7 of Buildings and other Construction workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act and the construction labour shall get the registration under section 12 of the act before making payment of running bills
All materials required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer himself and should be got tested by the quality control authorities at his own cost before use on work.
Star rates are not applicable .
The Earnest Money Deposit Total Rs. 7400/- shall be made in single payment through e-payment only in favour of Executive Engineer PWD, Division, GADAG.
Tender period for work completion 12 Calendar Months
Tenderer should maintain the road free from pothole from the commencement of work, other wise action will be taken for termination of tender.
Royalty Charges will be Deducted in every bill of contract as per rules
The Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time

All safety precautions warning signs night illumination reflectors deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. The contractor should indemnify the client to that extent
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the standard tender documents KW-1 KPWD and further orders thereon
Within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit for an amount 5% of the Contract price
Only relevant document needs to be uploaded. un-necessary documents or any kind of fake documents will lead to rejection of tender.
Any Deviation or error or Mistakes found in units of items they should be read as in the unified SR 2023-24 and Continued to 2024-25 the rates shall be quoted accordingly

As per this note, each tenderer should demonstrate availability of few key equipments / machinery for execution of the work. However as per Govt circular no GO-FD/AE 263/EXP12-2022 dt 11-05-2022, this clause for owning key equipments for works costing up to Rs.3.00 crores is exempted.
This bid documents clause No. 34.4 to be implemented as per deligation of power vide GO No. 423 FC-1 2018 Bangalore dated 24.09.2018
Conditional tenders are not accepted
The Contractor belonging to the Catogery-IIA shall be domicile of the State of Karnataka for more than 10 years Compulsory

Contractors registered under class-1 and 2 may tender for works anywhere in the state.Contactors registered under class-3 may tender for works within the districts of the PWD circles where in they are registered. Contactors registered under-4 may tender for works within the districts or within the division whichever is applicable
The Tenderer should be a PWD Registered Class IV & above contractor.

As per the Secial Gazzette Finance Secretriat Notification No 876 Exp-12/2017 Bengaluru Dated 15.09.2017 & Govt order No-FD-506 EXP-12/2024 Bngalore DT:20.08.2024 the following conditions shall apply for the works reserved for Scheduled caste and Scheduled Tribes & Category-I and Category IIA If no Qualified Tenderers belonging to Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes & Category-I and Category IIA Participate in the bid in two attempts under this rule, then these two works shall be tendered as open catergory wherein all eligible bidders of General or Scheduled castes and Scheduled Tribes category can participate.
Road maintenance period is one year from the date of work order issued.

itemList.description: Clearing    and    grubbing    road    land    including    uprooting    rank vegetation,  grass,  bushes,  shrubs,  saplings  and  trees  girth  up  to 300  mm,  removal  of  stumps  of  trees  cut  earlier  and  disposal  of unserviceable  materials  and  stacking  of  serviceable  material  to be used or auctioned,  including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness. By Mechanical Means using Dozer - In area of light jungle

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Drains - The maintenance of drains include erosion, repair, clearing, cleaning,  reshaping,  regrading,  deepening  of  side  drains as well as catch water drains as per technical specification Clause 1908. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1908
Maintenance of Earth Shoulder (stripping excess soil) - Stripping excess soil from the shoulder surface to achieve the approved level and compacting with plate compactor. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003

Restoration of rain cuts with soil, moorum, gravel or a mixture of these, clearing the loose soil, benching for 300 mm width, laying  fresh  material  in  layers  not  exceeding  250  mm  and compacting with plate compactor or power rammers to restore the original alignment, levels and slopes. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3002

Patching of Potholes - Patching of Shallow Potholes using SDBC Gr II 25 mm thick - Patching  of  shallow  potholes  on  asphalt  surfaces  by  using Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete 25mm thickness. The Cost is inclusive of removing the failed materials & cleaning on the road surface, preparation of potholes to the required standards sizes before patching them and application of tack coat at 0.20 kg/ m2 over the asphalt surface including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: White  washing  of  parapet  walls  of  CD  work  and  tree trunks - White washing two coats on parapet walls and tree trunks including preparation of surface by cleaning scraping etc. as per technical specifications. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1916

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Culverts - Maintenance  of  Hume  pipe  Culvert  by  way  of    Clearing, Cleaning, Erosion repair, repairs to cracks, parapet wall and protection work as per drawing and technical specification Clause 1909. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1909

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Culverts Slab type - Maintenance   of   Slab   type   Culverts   by   way   of   clearing, Cleaning, Erosion repair, repairs to cracks, parapet walls and Protection works as per drawing and technical specification. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1909

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -4- SUB-BASES, BASES (NON-BITUMINOUS), SHOULDERS AND STABILIZATION METHODS
itemList.description: Wet Mix Macadam (Plant Mix Method) - Providing,   laying,   spreading   and   compacting   graded   stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory rollerto achieve the desireddensity. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 406

Prime Coat over WMM/WBM - Providing  and  applying  primer  coat  with  SS1  grade  Bitumen Emulsion   on   prepared   surface   of   granular   base   including cleaning of road surface and spraying primer at the rate of 0.70 kg/m2  using mechanical means. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 502

Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete - Providing  and  laying  Semi  Dense  Bituminous  Concrete  with 40/60  TPH  capacity   hot  mix  plant  batch  type  using  crushed aggregates of specified grading premixed with bituminous binder VG-30  @  5%  by  weight  of  mix  and  filler,  transported  to  site, laid over a previously prepared surface with mechanical paver finisher to the required grade, level and alignment and rolled as per MoRTH V revision. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - IRC-37:2018

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -3- EARTH WORK, EROSION CONTROL AND DRAINAGE
itemList.description: Compacting Original Ground - Compacting original ground supporting embankment - Loosening, leveling  and Compacting original ground supporting embankment to facilitate placement of first layer of embankment, scarified to a depth of 150 mm, mixed with water at OMC and then compacted  by  rolling  so  as  to  achieve  minimum  dry  density  as given in Table 300-2 for embankment construction. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 305.3.4

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of 200 m and km stones - Maintenance of 200 m & km stones by way of refiting of tilted stones  repairing  with  cement  mortar,  cleaning,  repairing and lettering on 200 m & km stone and  5th km stone as per drawing and technical specification. -Painting two coats with synthetic enamel paint. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1913

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of 200 m and km stones - Maintenance of 200 m & km stones by way of refiting of tilted stones  repairing  with  cement  mortar,  cleaning,  repairing and lettering on 200 m & km stone and  5th km stone as per drawing and technical specification. -Printing  letters  and  figures  of  any  shade  with  synthtic enamel  paint  of  any  approved  colour  to  give  an  even shade. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1913

Patching of Deep Potholes 75mm thick by restoring the Granular Base course using material confirming to WBM Grade -II with type B Screenings standards wherever necessary by manual means including trimming the pothole to the required shape and size, cleaning the pothole, applying Prime Coat (SS1) at 0.70kg per m over the WBM surface and covering the surface with SDBC 25mm thick including lead.
loading unloading, rolling rolli and finishing etc., complete as per specification.
